title: AgentReadinessSignal
description: A single observable signal that an API provider supports a specific dimension of agent readiness, with an evidence URL that anchors the score.

id.description: Stable identifier for the signal, typically `{providerSlug}-{dimensionSlug}`.

provider.description: Canonical name of the API provider this signal describes.

providerSlug.description: Lowercased, hyphenated slug used for cross-references.

dimension.description: The agent-readiness dimension being scored. See vocabulary/agent-readiness-vocabulary.yaml for the canonical list.

score.description: Score from 0 (absent) to 3 (best-in-class). 0=absent, 1=partial/undocumented, 2=present and documented, 3=present, documented, and machine-discoverable.

scoreLabel.description: Human-readable label corresponding to the numeric score.

evidenceUrl.description: Public URL that anchors the score. The page or file an auditor can read to verify the claim.

evidenceQuote.description: Optional verbatim quote from the evidence URL supporting the score.
evidenceQuote.example: This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API.

notes.description: Free-form notes from the reviewer, e.g. caveats or version applicability.
notes.example: Spec is split into preview and stable; both are kept in sync with the changelog.

observer.description: Person or organisation that recorded the signal.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering and grouping signals.
